governance_basis.fact: M2 is not met; an independent labeled holdout and accuracy/performance evidence are still required.
No independent blinded real-source labels are recorded; precision and recall are not estimable.
D41 froze detector 0.17.0 and is not current-version accuracy evidence.
D41's 99-case packet was post-scan stratified and has zero independent labels; it is not a population accuracy sample.
D48 is a convenience source sample; its 97 files were partial, scan was blocked, and no labels are available.
These are component/CVE replay evidence with partial coverage, not independently sampled and labeled holdout data.
Pasteboard records are targeted source/config investigations; D53 source/config correlation does not establish a built product.

sampling.if_frame_or_independence_unavailable: stop_not_ready; do not substitute D41, D48, D49-D53, prior D development, or synthetic cases

freeze_requirements: repository commit/tree and eligible scope hashes
runtime environment and replay driver hash

metric_denominators.precision: TP / (TP + FP) among adjudicable frozen scanner findings; show unknown candidate count/rate and adjudicable fraction
metric_denominators.recall: TP / (TP + FN) over all independently identified adjudicated supported_risk units in exhaustively reviewed scope, or a valid preregistered probability sample with design weights
metric_denominators.unknown: reported separately; never silently assigned to TP, FP, FN, or TN
metric_denominators.interval_design: 95% interval accounting for repository-level clustering and sample design

hard_stop_conditions: No auditable independent sampling frame or source-independence evidence
Source commit/tree/scope/blob identity cannot be verified
Scanner is dirty or detector/model/profile/parser/scope hashes are missing or changed after freeze
Selection, exclusions, inclusion probabilities, or seed are missing or influenced by scan output
Fewer than two independent qualified reviewers, prediction disclosure before label freeze, or incomplete review for recall
Missing original label files, adjudication record, source-bound evidence, or hash-frozen analysis inputs
Partial or not-run coverage prevents the particular claim from being judged
Minimum cohort floors not met; stop population claim and report descriptive pilot only
Source/output mutated or reproducibility cannot be reconstructed
m2_exit_criteria: Independent and provenance-bound cohort selected using the preregistered auditable design
Scanner bundle frozen before scan and labels
Two independent blind labels per unit plus independent adjudication of disagreements/metric-relevant unknowns
Exhaustive prediction-blind miss review or valid weighted probability design for recall
Track-specific TP/FP/FN/unknown, precision/recall denominators and intervals, coverage, runtime, and peak RSS reported
Reproducible raw artifacts and hash-verifying scoring code
D owner review of limitations and readiness evidence
current_missing_inputs: independent source inventory and frozen sampling frame
prior-use overlap ledger and eligible cohort with verified identities
pre-scan selection record, inclusion probabilities, and seed record
frozen scanner and model/profile/parser/configuration hashes for the target evaluation version
two qualified independent reviewers and conflict declarations
approved immutable storage for sealed predictions and separated labels
scope_limit: Source-level holdout evidence cannot establish product applicability or satisfy M3 by itself.
